## Samsung Officially Launches Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, Flip8, Watch Ultra2, and Watch9 Across Southeast Asia and Oceania

Foldable availability in SE Asia and Oceania is a near-term competitiveness signal for Samsung's premium device cycle; rollout breadth and timing relative to Apple's cycle affects handset share and ASP mix in these markets ahead of the next iPhone launch window.

- Samsung has made its new foldable lineup — Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 — commercially available across Southeast Asia and Australia
- The launch also includes Galaxy Watch Ultra2 and Watch9
- The rollout spans multiple markets across Southeast Asia and Oceania simultaneously
- This marks the regional availability milestone for Samsung's latest premium foldable refresh cycle
